USB Utility Drive for IT Support

I highly recommend Portable Apps. Portable Apps is designed to be installed on a thumb drive and run directly form there without making any changes on the local machine. Once you install the Portable Apps base, you can then use the app to install useful utilities.

Some of the utilities I have installed are:

  • Autoruns
  • Google Chrome
  • Clam Win
  • Hijack This
  • Process Monitor
  • Spybot S&D
  • WinSCP

I keep a working copy on my hard drive and update my thumb drive from that periodically.

EDIT:

I've also found YUMI very useful. YUMI allows you to boot from your thumb drive to multiple operating systems. IT's a life saver when someone hoses their machine and didn't bother putting important files on their shared drive.
CCleaner is a pretty good program for cleaning up log files and caches. OnyX on the Mac side does well with this for others in the thread.
